contents: 1568 teams trimmed to 71. The full response is 1542967 bytes.

trimming.reason: players carries real people's names. SPEC excludes player data from this project, and the repo is public. The parser is required to discard the field, so removing it costs no test fidelity. See fixtures/README.md.
selection: every team required to resolve the major-league matches in rest_getSchedule.json and rest_getSchedule_ewc.json (64 codes)
both halves of the only colliding code: EG 103461966951059521 (LCS) and EG 109218871531830908 (LEC)
one active team with homeLeague null (486 exist upstream; none may enter the team table)
one archived team (392 exist upstream; excluded by status alone)
three LCK Challengers teams whose codes (DK, KT, HLE) collide with the main LCK rosters beside them
trimming.ordering: sorted by id, so a re-trim of an unchanged upstream response is byte-identical

verification.hl: verified. Captured by an explicit request with hl=en-US; the response's homeLeague.region values are English (KOREA, INTERNATIONAL, ...), and getLeagues was confirmed on 2026-08-09 to return "KOREA" under en-US and "韓國" under zh-TW.
verification.capturedOn: verified. Recorded from `date -u` at the moment of the request, not inferred afterwards.
verification.queryParams: verified. hl is the only parameter sent; getTeams takes no others and returns the whole master table.
verification.identityOfIds: cross-checked, n=2 teams. getTeams id 99566404850008779 (Suzhou LNG Esports) and 99566404848691211 (Invictus Gaming) match rest_getEventDetails.json exactly, and the first also matches the suffix of the GraphQL composite id. Three endpoints agree on one team and two on the other. Strong, but a four-cell table rather than a survey -- this field previously read "verified", which overstated it.
verification.byteIdenticalToPriorCapture: The live capture was byte-identical (1542967 bytes, cmp clean) to an undocumented curl taken earlier the same day, so the trimmed content is unchanged by the re-capture. The re-capture exists to give this sidecar verified provenance rather than inferred provenance.

transform.why: players carries real people's names; SPEC excludes player data and the parser discards this field regardless, so removing it costs no test fidelity.

the 71 rows selected per trimming.selection below: every team needed to resolve rest_getSchedule.json / rest_getSchedule_ewc.json, both halves of the one colliding code (EG), one null-homeLeague row, one archived row, and three LCK Challengers rows that collide on code with their parent orgs.

measurements.note: Measured against the FULL 1568-row response, not this trimmed file. The trimmed file cannot support these figures. As of this change the full response is committed at fixtures/riot-lol/rest_getTeams_full.json (players stripped; see its own .meta.json), so these figures are asserted directly in tests/team-index-collisions.test.ts and re-derivable by anyone from a clone -- not merely disclosed as unverifiable. Re-run npm run capture -- getTeams ... to check them against a fresh live response.
measurements.measuredOn: 2026-08-09 capture; team-table figures re-measured 2026-08-11 after coverage narrowed to eight leagues

collisionsByCandidateSet.note: Re-measured 2026-08-11 while choosing the join key. An earlier version of this file recorded 27 colliding codes among all active rows; that was wrong -- 46 codes collide, and 27 is the count of collisions involving an academy squad. Nothing could catch it because the full response is not committed and no test asserts it.
collisionsByCandidateSet.ofTheActiveCodeCollisions: 27 of the 46 are a first team and its own Challengers/Academy/Youth squad, because a code names the ORGANISATION rather than the squad. This is why the join key is name.

teamTable.filter: status == active AND homeLeague.name in teamHomeLeagueSlugs() -- the covered REGIONAL leagues only (lck, lpl, lec, lcs, lcp). NOT majorSlugs(): the three international events must not define who the teams are.
teamTable.joinKey: name (trimmed, lower-cased); code is the fallback and a fallback hit raises team-name-mismatch

ifInternationalEventsWereIncluded.note: Five 2011-era orgs homed at Worlds (EPIK, GDEE, AAA, PCFC, XAN) plus two region placeholder entities homed at MSI whose codes are literally LCS and VCS. No collision results today, which is why this had to be measured rather than assumed.

supersededByCoverageChange.filter: the 14 major leagues of config/leagues.json before 2026-08-11
supersededByCoverageChange.note: Kept so that figures quoted from older drafts can be traced rather than looking like errors.

inThisTrimmedFile.note: What the committed 71 rows can actually support, and what the tests assert.

recaptureNotes.supersededNote: This file previously said the full response must never be committed under any name. That is reversed as of this change: fixtures/riot-lol/rest_getTeams_full.json commits the full 1568-row response with the SAME stripField(players) transform applied, which removes the only personal-data field. What changes is that the load-bearing collision figures in docs/sources/lolesports-rest.md and config/leagues.json are now re-derivable by anyone from a clone, instead of only by whoever holds the ungitignored rest_getTeams_en.json. See fixtures/riot-lol/rest_getTeams_full.meta.json.
recaptureNotes.howToRecapture: RIOT_ESPORTS_API_KEY=... npm run capture -- getTeams fixtures/riot-lol/rest_getTeams_full — then run npm run capture:refresh fixtures/riot-lol/rest_getTeams.json, which reads this recapture.transform block, applies it to the full capture, and reports whether the result still matches the committed 71 rows.
